versions.changelog:
Initial release of picrd-image-hosting.

- Provides free image hosting via picrd.com with permanent, embeddable URLs—no account required.
- Supports PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF up to 10 MB per file.
- Allows creation and management of image albums.
- Enforces upload rate limit (60 per hour per IP); no read/download limits.
- Includes clear CLI curl examples and error handling tips for file size/rate issues.
- Emphasizes one-time secret delete URL and data privacy cautions.
